description: Create an owned old-site/new-site plan. Next call import_inventory for the old and new URL lists; planning does not crawl or run the model.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended change; retry an uncertain call with the identical input and key.

new_site.description: Origin of available destination pages, e.g. https://new.example; no path, query, fragment or credentials.

old_site.description: Origin of existing source pages, e.g. https://old.example; no path, query, fragment or credentials.

site_aliases.description: Additional explicitly allowed origins per side (www or staging). Aliases are never inferred.

name: plan_migration
title: Plan a migration
